response.description: Hardware Audit Logging for Azure Cloud HSM provides hardware-generated audit records for supported HSM management operations, helping organizations strengthen security monitoring, compliance reporting, governance, and forensic investigations. Customers can access human-readable records alongside HSM-signed binary audit data, signatures, and certificates to independently verify the authenticity and integrity of signed audit batches. Audit events are delivered to Azure Monitor Log Analytics for use in existing monitoring and investigation workflows.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Cloud HSM hardware audit logging
